entities.summary: Maria Lea Pedini-Angelini served as a Captain Regent of San Marino from 1 April 1981 to 1 October 1981. She served with Gastone Pasolini. She was the first female head of state of San Marino and, at age 26, the youngest non-royal state leader in Europe since 1900. She later served as Director in the Ministry of Government and Foreign Affairs.
